# Human Evaluation and Rubrics {#sec-human-evaluation-rubrics}

The human label is not a primitive. It is the output of a protocol: who was asked, what they were shown, what rubric they followed, how disagreement was handled, and which cases were later audited. If that protocol is weak, calling the result "human judgment" only hides the weakness.

This chapter sits between statistics and model judges. It treats human evaluation as an instrument that must be designed, calibrated, and versioned before it can train rewards in @sec-rlhf, validate judges in @sec-judging-holistic, or gate releases in @sec-operational-evaluation.
